performance.verdict: CPL efficient but GHL pipeline and 5 overdue SOW milestones silently block monetisation.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue (earliest Jul 20): GHL build gaps, end-to-end stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch all unverified — each is a confirmed scale or attribution blocker.
28-day CPL is $15.85 on 138 Meta leads; last-3-day signal (Sep 8–10: 10+12+6=28 leads) vs prior 3 (Sep 5–7: 0+0+6=6 leads) shows a sharp volume recovery — efficiency holding.
Google Ads spent $507.22 over 28 days and recorded 0 conversions; client-side pixel likely broken — spend is running blind with no attribution.
GBP: 83 impressions, 41 direction actions, 0 calls over 28 days; flag gbp_no_calls_with_impressions confirmed — profile drives foot-traffic intent but phone CTA is not converting.
GHL shows 138 leads but only 132 opportunities created and 0 won, 0 appointments — intake gap of at least 6 contacts not entering pipeline; not an ads problem, an intake routing issue.

suggestions.text: Fix Google Ads conversion pixel — $507.22 spent in 28 days with 0 conversions means spend is running attribution-blind.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $507.22 over the last 28 days and recorded zero conversions, confirmed as a client-side pixel issue rather than a campaign failure. Tag the conversion action in GTM or Google Ads directly and verify a test conversion fires before the next reporting cycle. Success is confirmed when at least one conversion registers within 48 hours of the fix going live. Target resolution: 2026-09-13.

suggestions.text: Resolve 5 overdue SOW milestones — Becklar/BWS verification and paid landing pages are confirmed scale blockers as of Aug 31.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are overdue, the earliest since July 20: Stripe Products QA, GHL build gaps (Becklar billing, BWS duplicate check), end-to-end stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch. Each blocks scaling or attribution — none can be treated as done until a completed event is logged. Nacer to triage and assign owners this week; paid landing pages and stack re-test are the highest-leverage unblocks. Success is each item marked complete with evidence (Loom or test log) by 2026-09-19.

suggestions.text: Watch GHL intake: 138 leads vs 132 opportunities and 0 appointments — confirm routing fix before acting; re-check Sep 14.
